draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.83, the 199th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 30th of 35 at WR. He went 209th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: vertical jump (84th percentile). College production: 439 receiving yards in 2020, 28th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.
